item.title: The Gorton and Denton by-election is a test of Labour’s traditional voter base - The Meteor
item.description: Gorton and Denton goes to the polls today, 26 February 2026, in the second vote ever for the new constituency. In any other time it’d be a shoo-in for Labour, but we certainly live in interesting times now. Let’s take a look at the evolution of the constituency and consider what the future holds.
